parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the page to return. Default value: **1**, which indicates the first page.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description:
The ID of the brute-force attacks prevention rule.
>You can invoke the [DescribeAntiBruteForceRules](~~DescribeAntiBruteForceRules~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the brute-force attacks prevention rule.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return on each page in a paged query. This parameter is used for paging.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The IP address of the access source.
